Responsive grid

Source: R/layout.R
shad_grid.Rd

A CSS grid with either a fixed (optionally per-breakpoint) column count or a responsive auto-fit track list.

Usage

shad_grid(
  ...,
  cols = NULL,
  min_width = NULL,
  template = NULL,
  gap = 4,
  align = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

shad_grid_item(..., span = 1, class = NULL)

Arguments

...

Children, or named HTML attributes for the root.

cols

Column count: a number, or a named vector over base/sm/md/lg.

min_width

Minimum column width for an auto-fit grid (e.g. "16rem"). Takes precedence over cols.

template

An explicit grid-template-columns value, e.g. "1fr 2fr". Takes precedence over both.

gap

Gap between cells: a spacing token step (default 4) or a CSS length.

align

Block-axis alignment of cells: "stretch" (default), "start", "center", "end".

class

Extra CSS classes.

span

Number of columns this cell spans, or "full" for the whole row.

Value

A <div> tag.

Details

Pass cols as a single number for a fixed count, or as a named vector over the breakpoints base/sm/md/lg (40rem / 48rem / 64rem) — unnamed entries are the base. Each breakpoint falls back to the one below it, so cols = c(base = 1, md = 3) is two rules, not four.

min_width is usually simpler still: it lays out as many equal columns as fit at that minimum width, with no breakpoints at all.

See also

Other shadshiny layout: shad_container(), shad_page_navbar(), shad_page_sidebar(), shad_stack()

Examples

shad_grid(shad_value_box("1", "One"), shad_value_box("2", "Two"),
          min_width = "12rem")
#> <div class="shad-grid shad-grid--auto" style="--shad-grid-gap:var(--shad-space-4);--shad-grid-min:12rem;">
#>   <div class="shad-value-box">
#>     <div class="shad-value-box__label">One</div>
#>     <div class="shad-value-box__value">1</div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-value-box">
#>     <div class="shad-value-box__label">Two</div>
#>     <div class="shad-value-box__value">2</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
shad_grid(shad_card("a"), shad_card("b"), cols = c(base = 1, md = 2))
#> <div class="shad-grid" style="--shad-grid-cols:1;--shad-grid-cols-md:2;--shad-grid-gap:var(--shad-space-4);">
#>   <div class="shad-card">a</div>
#>   <div class="shad-card">b</div>
#> </div>
